state_profile.voting_summary: Oklahoma votes mostly on election day (75% in 2024), with a short early in-person window and no-excuse mail at 7%. Polls close at 8 p.m. Eastern; absentee and early votes are released first, election day precincts follow rapidly, and Oklahoma is routinely among the first states to finish, essentially complete by late evening. Mail ran D+2 against R+37 on election day, so the small first batches read far bluer than the state's finish.
